objective: The new cheetahs in the game: the Cheetah and the Lightning Cheetah get the faceted models of decision 0053, and the Fire Cheetah joins as the Cheetah's legendary variant (twist strength).
acceptance_criteria: The Cheetah, the Lightning Cheetah and the Fire Cheetah load in the game with the new models, rigged and animated like every creature, in the colours of the concept cards
A legendary roll on a Cheetah hatches a Fire Cheetah; a mythic roll still hatches a Lightning Cheetah; no other odds change
The cheetahs' clips fit the new models
verification: 2026-11-15: upload-assets run 43767875270 succeeded (three models, three textures, exported without vertex colours). Lune 687/687, selene and stylua clean. In Studio (local build): the Cheetah, the Lightning Cheetah and the Fire Cheetah load with the new models in the colours of the concept cards, and their portraits are published. Each leg's and the tail's lowest point was measured against the ground in the idle, attack, power attack, hit and win poses: the power attack's coil (front paws 0.5 to 0.6 studs under) and bound (hind paws 0.2 and the tail 1.3 under) and the win pose (tail 0.3 under) were fixed and measured again, all within 0.1 of the ground or clear of it. A test wave 10 with the three cheetahs as the team was won with no script errors. Left as it is: the shared hit flinch sinks the hind paws 0.2 studs for a moment. Not checked: phones, two players, a Fire Cheetah from a real hatch, the clips in motion at full speed.
notes: SHANNON approved the three cheetahs on 2026-11-15 and asked for them in the game. The upload runs in GitHub (environment assets), never with a key on this machine.
